PROJECT / PAYMENT-TO-ACCESS RECOVERY

Payment is a fact.
Access needs proof.

A customer paid for a course. The lesson is locked. PayTrace follows the evidence, proposes the smallest safe correction, and checks the outcome—with the merchant in control.

HOW IT WORKS

A narrow correction.
A complete explanation.

01 / INVESTIGATE

Find the break

Compare payment, purchase identity and course access. Ledger checks payment; Relay follows handoffs; Patch proposes a change; Prism challenges the evidence.

02 / DECIDE

Review before writing

Rehearse the exact entitlement change. Changed evidence invalidates approval. Missing, conflicting or uncertain evidence keeps the case on hold.

03 / VERIFY

Check the actual lesson

Reread the payment and access records, then check protected content. Verification retries read again without repeating the grant. Proof expires.

BUILT INTO THE PROJECT

One case. Both sides.

Merchant tools and a private customer journey share evidence while keeping private notes and internal decisions separate.

Merchant workspace

Today dashboard, searchable queue, priorities, reminders, next-update promises, case timeline, related cases and a decision brief.

Explore the desk →

Customer experience

Private progress links, two-way messages, information requests, access self-check, browser receipt and separate success or help responses.

Follow the buyer journey →

Evidence & reporting

Recovery Passport, Break Point Map, flight recorder, expiring receipt, CSV, analytics and run reports labeling connected, demo and incomplete checks.

Open Recovery Center →

Store integration

Sandbox storefront, authenticated purchase intake, idempotency, JSON mapping previews and PayPal-checked mapping activation.

Open Connection Studio →

Bounded automation

Scheduled follow-ups, payment rereads and durable jobs. Sandbox autopilot is opt-in, limited and off by default. AI cannot approve a write.

Inspect connections →

Team & operations

Role-based access, redaction, OIDC/MFA integration, audit records, health diagnostics and encrypted backup with restore-check tooling.

Account setup →

VALIDATION / NOVEMBER 4, 2026

Built is different
from live-tested.

The reviewed main baseline passed 276 automated tests. Those tests use local records and mocked provider contracts; they do not establish a completed external recovery.

What each level of evidence establishes
EvidenceWhat it establishesBoundary
Automated suiteRecovery safety, HTTP boundaries, privacy, intake, Passport and retry invariantsLocal and mocked contracts
Interactive sampleThe intended merchant and buyer journeyFictional records and scripted agents
Connection checkA service responds to a bounded checkNot a completed checkout or recovery
Connected acceptanceOne case has all required fresh provider evidenceRequires private setup and a recorded run

Still needs connected acceptance: PayPal sandbox checkout through recovery, Render tasks, identity/MFA, email delivery and the receiving course platform. Earlier deployment notes describe AI evaluation and course-service reads; this review does not independently repeat those private tests.
